notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! I took the entire day yesterday to deep dive into our custom physics system and fix the steering bug! The issue causing it was related to an interpolation function and a case where the steering could runaway reaching very high values. The new system is fully frame independent and should give you the same steering sensitivity at any fps.[/p][p]Definitely let us know if any other issues pop up :) 
[/p][p]Changes[/p][p]- rewrote interpolation code to be completely framerate independent[/p][p]- added cheese triggers to Redwoods (Redwood time leaderboard will be reset as a result of this)[/p][p]- improved Redwood tree textures[/p][p]- added additional terrain texture and adjusted settings to improve pop-in of grass in Redwoods[/p][p]- minor adjustments to materials in Redwoods[/p][p][/p][p]Bugfixes[/p][p]- fixed issue that could cause steering runaway[/p][p]- fixed some trees partially floating over the ground in Redwoods[/p]

notes.title: Post launch update
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! Especially players new to Driftwood![/h3][p]
It was really unfortunate that the 1.0 launched with so many bugs! It was a perfect storm between little tested systems and the biggest influx of new players we have had so far. It was naive of us to think that changing so many things at the core of the game would go smoothly and that's our bad! We were mostly happy to deliver a ton of new features! It might sound strange, but when you test a game with 10-20 people over a longer time, some bugs just don't pop up until hundreds of people play like yesterday. Except the challenge issues of course, that was just not great.

Huge thanks to everyone who has been reporting bugs here and on discord! 

[/p][h3]So what now?[/h3][p]Hotfix 5 is uploading at the moment and it includes player log file recording. This means you can simply send us your log file after a bug happened and it should greatly improve how fast we can fix things, especially for those hard to replicate bugs because we (I, the one programmer on Driftwood) can actually see what happened! If you experience any bugs go to to appdata/locallow/StokedSloth right after and send us the Player.log file on discord in the #bugboard channel! ❤️  

[url="https://discord.gg/wt7uvAYU"]https://discord.gg/wt7uvAYU[/url]

Also in Hotfix 5
- fixed hidden passage and river gap challenge

Our goal for the next few days is to resolve 99% of the severe bugs coming up, so everyone can enjoy a smooth ride!
Thanks for playing Driftwood 🦥🛹
[/p]

notes.title: Full release!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! The day is finally here! Driftwood 1.0 is live now! 
❤️🦥🛹🙃🥳🌲

[/p][h1]Changelog 1.0.0[/h1][p]
[/p][h2]Features[/h2][p]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Added a start menu
[*] Online multiplayer (p2p) with three modes (Free, Race, Highscore)
[*] Play in a private lobby with friends or join a public lobby
[*] Toggle traffic collision and collisions in your lobby
[*] Host options to change the settings or level at any time
[*] Completely new hub world with 5 islands
[*] Added two new levels for a total of 15
[*] Coin based progression system
[*] All milestones are challenges now
[*] Each level has more challenges (100 total!)
[*] New van physics
[*] Added Cheese leaderboards
[*] Level card button navigation
[*] View leaderboards from the menu/level card
[*] New spark particle effect when using slide gloves
[*] Added tank controls for the van when using mouse & keyboard
[*] Added deck skins, grip tape and wheels tints as unlockables
[/list]
[h3]New Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fog Rush
[*] Swiss Level
[/list]
[h3]Added Cosmetics[/h3]New Deck Skins:
[list]
[*] Cecropia Plant
[*] Hot Tea
[*] Hot Coffee
[*] Hot Ramen
[*] Cut Pineapple
[*] Water Lily
[/list]
New Grip Tape Skins:
[list]
[*] Waves
[*] Flames
[/list]
New Outfits:
[list]
[*] Rain Poncho
[*] Bath Robe
[*] Leather Jacket
[*] Ripped Jeans
[*] Flip Flops
[*] Slippers
[*] Racing Suit Pants
[*] Racing Suit Top
[*] Jogging Pants
[*] Dino Pants
[/list]
New Boards:
[list]
[*] Ironing Board
[*] Secret Board (unlock 60 Coins to open present on Van-Map)
[/list]
		
[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][p]
[list]
[*] Removed old main menu
[*] Simplified end of level UI
[*] Added snow to cliffs in upper part of “Nordic Frost”
[*] Added polish to upper area of “Cali Coastline”
[*] Added polish to “Maryhill”
[/list]

[/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][p]
[list]
[*] Fixed a physics issue where respawning would clip you through the ground
[*] Fixed inconsistent leaderboard ranks in menu
[/list]


[h2]Here we just want to say THANK YOU to everyone who has been part of this journey![/h2]

After roughly 2 Years in Early Access Driftwood is now at version 1.0! Some of the most noticeable additions to the game since our Early Access launch in 2023 have been:

[list]
[*] Increasing the amount of levels from 4 to 15
[*] Revamping the van map and single player progression system
[*] Adding the online multiplayer
[*] Adding a many new boards, wheels & outfits
[/list]

We are proud of how far we have come and feel like we have delivered on our original Early Access pitch from two years ago. That said, we plan to continue to support the game in post-launch updates and especially with hotfixes in the upcoming week. While we are happy with everything we have added we still feel like there is room for more content, features and polish. 

Join our Discord Server to talk to us, give us feedback, or simply hang out with our lovely community.
Thank you to everyone who supported us up to this point.
Thank you for giving feedback, being patient and joining the community.
But most importantly...
Thank you for playing!

All the best, 

Leo & Jason

notes.title: Driftwood 1.0 is releasing on August 1st with a brand new online multiplayer!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! Leo & Jason here - the devs of Driftwood![/h3]

After two years in early access we are announcing the official release date today, August 1 this summer, and are sharing a first look at a major new feature... a brand new online multiplayer!

[previewyoutube=WwcpfzLca6A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's coming in 1.0?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play with your friends in the new Online Multiplayer mode!
[*] Enjoy a completely overhauled progression system + new van map
[*] Complete many new challenges
[*] A new map
[*] New outfits & gear
[/list]
[h3]Price change[/h3]
As we mentioned in the previous post, we are increasing the price of Driftwood. Since early access we have added 8+ maps, new cosmetics, new boards & wheels and with the upcoming multiplayer we think it is fair to match the price of similar games at $19.99. 

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
Thank you so much for sticking with us throughout the early access time and a special shoutout to our community on Discord! ❤️🦥

Features:

- turned a community favourite skip into a new official shortcut in "Eagle Stone Mountain"

Bugfixes:
- fixed clipping value on trees in Dolomites, making them more lush again
- fixed maps not being directly startable in the van Map by pressing X or A (depending on Controller)
- Increased distance of some assets in Alpine Cliffs to avoid clipping in "high" graphic settings  
- cleaned up grass patches on roads (some might still persist) 


Known issues:
- Volume slider does not fully effect all sounds
- Trees in Vineyard Hills switching to imposter Trees too Early



On top of that, we are very happy to announce that our next update including our second wildcard level is dropping next week! You will hear more from us soon, thank you for playing & have a lovely day!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.2b
notes.content:
Huge thanks to everyone in the community that playtested our demo and provided feedback. It is absolutely invaluable to us! 😊🦥

We fixed some of the issues in small updates over the weekend and are adding some small new features in this latest update now. The patch notes summarize all updates since last Friday.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added input icons for Xbox and Playstation controllers as well as keyboard and mouse
[*] Added more resolutions and widescreen support
[*] Added dpad input for menu navigation
[*] Added sorting by score or time in leaderboard
[*] Added extra info to Tutorial prompt in the board selection screen
[*] Added wind break sound to air break pose (left stick fully back)
[*] Added subtle experimental speed indicator in score bar while gaining points
[*] Added more sloth facts in loading screen
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced pump force at higher speeds
[*] Changed default starting wheels to regular wheels
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed UI scaling for 16:10 aspect ratio
[*] Fixed anti-aliasing settings not being set correctly
[*] Fixed issues with keyboard input (opening in game menu, starting runs)
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main menu cards are cut off to the sides on widescreen monitors
[*] Changing the sorting of the leaderboard not possible using mouse & keyboard
[*] On occasion the finish UI is bugged and will not show up
[*] Sometimes the player crashes on respawn
[*] Camera angle stutters at very high speed
[*] Challenges in Eagle Stone Mountain have wrong states
[/list]
